status: frozen before any A6 outcome generation
scope: Fresh causal component test of whether explicit section labels versus no section labels change transition behavior when the four semantic chunks, their words, order, separators, single-user-turn topology, prose prior-state body, signal text, revision opportunity, model, generation, and scoring are held fixed. A6 localizes the remaining outer-scaffold component of the broad A4c inline-rendering effect after A5 isolated prior-state encoding; it does not introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A3: CAUSAL_INTERFACE_FORM_SIGNAL on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A4a: conversational topology causal on T_verified only; T_change and T_instability practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A4b: historical-prestate rendering causal on T_change only; T_instability and T_verified practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A4c: legacy-versus-canonical inline rendering causal on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified; all point estimates exceeded 0.05; analyzer required documented post-generation audit repair only
lineage.A5: prior-state field-versus-prose encoding causal on T_change and T_verified; T_instability practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A6_object: isolate explicit section-label scaffold versus unlabeled scaffold while holding the prose state body and all semantic chunk contents fixed

population.freshness: exclude every prior Pilot 0 plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, B0-v2, B1, A3, A4a, A4b, A4c, A5, and any A6 plumbing tasks from the confirmatory A6 cohort

invariants.conversation_topology: one user message -> assistant answer prefill

fixed_chunks.state_body: Your previous answer was <exact frozen initial answer>. Before feedback, you assigned probability <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals> that this answer was correct.

S_labeled.user_message:
QUESTION:
<question_body>

PREVIOUS STATE:
<state_body>

SIGNAL:
<signal_body>

REVISION REQUEST:
<revision_body>

S_unlabeled.interpretation: same four semantic chunks without section labels

scaffold_factor.causal_object: presence versus absence of the four prespecified section labels around otherwise identical semantic chunks under the same single-turn topology
semantic_identity_requirements: same E0 or EV signal text
scaffold_factor.allowed_difference: only the literal labels QUESTION:, PREVIOUS STATE:, SIGNAL:, and REVISION REQUEST: plus the newline immediately following each label may differ
not_authorized_as: psychological claim that labels cause instability

signal.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signal.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

factors.common_revision_instruction:
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create eight branch units per eligible prestate and randomize the four cell labels within block with exact 2/2/2/2 balance
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id fixes its own prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'a6::' + branch_id); scaffold and signal labels never enter the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same seed-assignment rule applies to every cell. Different rendered token sequences need not consume or realize identical stochastic draws. No claim of shared realized randomness is made.

transition_definitions.T_change: within a scaffold arm's two E0 branches, fraction whose final answer differs from the realized initial wrong answer
transition_definitions.T_instability: within a scaffold arm's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
transition_definitions.T_verified: within a scaffold arm's two EV branches, fraction ending on the objective benchmark key
transition_definitions.Q_N: within a scaffold arm, pooled neutral correct revisions divided by pooled neutral revisions; conditional on revision and not a primary endpoint

secondary_estimands.Q_N_scaffold_difference: Q_N(S_unlabeled) - Q_N(S_labeled), inferentially reported only if each scaffold arm has at least 20 neutral revision events
secondary_estimands.G_verified_minus_neutral_by_scaffold: same within-scaffold EV-minus-E0 final-correction contrast; transition-specific only and never a representation indicator

analysis.unit: frozen prestate block; generated branches are never treated as independent scientific observations
analysis.primary_randomization_tests: For Delta_S_change and Delta_S_instability, shuffle S_labeled/S_unlabeled labels only among the four E0 branches within each block preserving 2/2. For Delta_S_verified, shuffle S_labeled/S_unlabeled labels only among the four EV branches within each block preserving 2/2. Recompute block-level endpoints after every shuffle.
analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three two-sided blocked-randomization p-values; these are the only primary p-values.
analysis.effect_intervals: 95% whole-block bootstrap intervals for each primary block-level mean contrast
analysis.Q_N_analysis: If both scaffold arms meet the revision-event threshold, report pooled Q_N difference with a 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; otherwise mark not adjudicable. Q_N does not enter the primary multiplicity family or A6 summary gate.
analysis.secondary_interaction: Report Gamma_SE point estimate and 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; no secondary interaction p-value and no construct interpretation.

decision_gate.CAUSAL_SECTION_SCAFFOLD_SIGNAL: At least one of the three Holm-adjusted primary p-values is < 0.05. Report exactly which transition dimensions earned the signal and their signs/magnitudes.
decision_gate.SECTION_SCAFFOLD_WEAKENED_AT_A2_SCALE: No primary Holm-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 and all three primary 95% bootstrap intervals lie entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05]. This weakens explicit section scaffolding as the active remaining A4c outer-scaffold component at the inherited A2 practical scale; it does not invalidate A4c or A5.
decision_gate.A6_UNRESOLVED: Neither of the above gates is satisfied.
decision_gate.no_omnibus_construct: There is no global correction-capacity score and no requirement that all transition dimensions move together.

interpretation_guardrails: A6 tests explicit section-scaffold representation only; it does not test which scaffold is normatively better.

The four semantic chunk bodies, their order, separators, state values, signal semantics, revision instruction, and single-turn topology are held fixed; only the four prespecified section labels may differ.
A causal effect on T_instability earns authority only for explicit section-scaffold representation under the frozen assay; it does not identify a psychological or mechanistic cause of instability.
T_instability is the localized residual target motivating A6, but T_change, T_instability, and T_verified remain the inherited prespecified primary family.

A causal randomization result establishes a nonzero effect but does not by itself establish an effect exceeding the +/-0.05 practical threshold; causal difference and practical magnitude are separate gates.
A causal effect on one transition dimension does not imply effects on the others.
A null primary p-value alone does not weaken the component explanation; the frozen practical-equivalence gate is additionally required.
Cross-experiment A4c, A5, and A6 magnitudes are not algebraically decomposable because cohorts and manipulations differ.
Q_N remains conditional on revision and cannot be inferred when revision events are insufficient.
T_instability retains its exact two-replicate definition and has no inherent positive or negative normative valence.
Gamma_SE is a secondary factorial interaction, not a latent trait or new construct.
G_verified_minus_neutral is transition-specific and never a representation indicator.
If A6 is practically small for T_instability, the next step should discriminate remaining finer rendering differences versus interaction; neither is automatically established.
No A6 result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS; any such revision requires a separate earned update step.
